title: Remedy 'trace_store_reconciliation_remedy' for gap 'gap-123' has been dispatched 4 times in the last 6h without moving i
description: Remedy 'trace_store_reconciliation_remedy' for gap 'gap-123' has been dispatched 4 times in the last 6h without moving its target metric (every dispatch ACK'd green (202) while the target metric never moved). The gap-drain loop is silently re-dispatching an aborting remedy. Investigate why the downstream execution is not reaching, then either repair the remedy or reclassify the gap so the loop stops re-dispatching it.
